يستجنسون (form X)
# يَسْتَجْنِسُونَ (yastajnisūna) /jas.tad͡ʒ.ni.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
# يُسْتَجْنَسُونَ (yustajnasūna) /jus.tad͡ʒ.na.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَجْنَسَ (istajnasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
